rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and reported 3AA, but the image is somewhat indistinct; claims such as clearly demarcated ICM, cohesive TE around the periphery, and visibly thinned zona are somewhat overconfident from this single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, tubal factor diagnosis, semen parameters, endometrium, and cycle history with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with probability estimates tied to embryo quality and patient factors; minor overstatement of the impact of moderate alcohol and some speculative adjustments reduce perfection.

Mostly aligned with IVF practice regarding embryo grading and prognosis, but recommending routine PGT-A in a 28-year-old good-prognosis patient and suggesting low-dose aspirin are not strongly guideline-supported; acupuncture/CoQ10 are also more adjunctive than evidence-based standard care.
Provides clear practical steps for transfer and contingency planning, including lifestyle counseling and follow-up options, though some recommendations are broader or less evidence-based than ideal.
